origin: M6.3-6 motivates uninterrupted core bond lifespan, growth and valence, exposure, and variant specificity on new held-out seeds
note: One new preregistered campaign with ten scientific analyses; NOT ten independent campaigns

sample.construction: reuse the existing synthetic M6.3-1 bonded fixture, changing only seeds; same initial background per seed/density across arms; original M6 chemistry/energy/movement and RNG unchanged

steps_plan.task: freeze protocol, verify initial matched worlds and invariants
measure first event-time original bond break and censoring
trace original edge rupture, reformation and continuity
classify first growth and outsider prior bonding status
measure available core valence and energy-qualified slots
measure compatible free S0/S1 neighbors and eligible pairs
compare added-bond species and available substrates, with geometry controls
count disjoint A/B/C exact new motifs by source phase and near distance
verify all worlds, initial paired backgrounds, energy, RNG and independent replays
publish complete data, result of prespecified gates and scientific decision

definitions.pure: original three edges present and exactly the four source particles in one bonded aggregate
definitions.retained: three original edges present (may have broken and reformed)
definitions.unbroken: zero prior bond breaking events for any original edge; a previously broken edge reformed does NOT qualify
definitions.first_break: first original-edge BondEvent(kind=break) with post_step=event.step+1, right-censored at 450 if none
definitions.reformed: original-edge BondEvent(kind=form) after prior break of the same bond
definitions.growth: source component gains outsider; attachment event classified by outsider pre-step degree as free or bonded (could react earlier in same step)
definitions.eligible: post-step source-to-free adjacent pairs passing species, valence and energy constraints, a potential opportunity rather than observed pre-formation candidate count
definitions.new_motif: first observation per exact signature and sorted four physical IDs, excluding any history of shared bonded component with source atoms
definitions.near: toroidal Manhattan distance <=2 from original scaffold cells at first observation

analysis.primary: Time to first actual BondEvent break of any of the three original edges, separately by density and arm, including right-censoring; never conflate state occupancy with uninterrupted bond survival.
secondary: time original edges restored after earlier break
first attachment type: previously free monomer or bonded cluster
source valence and energy-qualified open slots per phase
free S0/S1 neighbors and eligible attachment pairs per phase
species of accepted source-outside bonds and local exposure
strict material-independent A/B/C four-node motifs near by phase and source motif
analysis.comparison: Report paired seed descriptive raw values for A,B,reverse and C per density, without p-values or causal inheritance inference.
analysis.signal_gate: Only flag a *screen signal* if EACH A,B,A_reverse,B_reverse arm in EACH density yields >=8 strict near A/B new motifs while original core edges retained, AND at least 9 of 12 seeds per arm have source-matched motif dominance, including reverse orientations, and no comparable C preference; else underpowered_or_no_specificity.
analysis.saturation_gate: Label valence bottleneck in this fixture only if at least 80% of post-growth source ticks have no energy-qualified open valence slots; not a universal impossibility.
analysis.limitations: The probe is artificially assembled; background and RNG divergence confound causal inference; density and species proportions both change slightly; this is a new seed set selected after the preceding exploratory campaigns, not a proof of evolution or ancestry.
analysis.no_changes: No engine, chemistry, RNG, config source, detector, existing protocol, or master modifications. No M7 promotion.

integrity.event_step: BondEvent.step=t occurs between observed steps t and t+1
integrity.fixed_replay_comparison: Independently rebuilt world must match final full hash, rng fingerprint and draws, energy, formations and breaks exactly
